thought.text: Clean start. Let me monitor boot and memory, plus check the Docling image pull:

reasoning_content: A new instance is starting up. This time the state should be clean. Let me monitor memory over the next few minutes as the services start up (this time there are no orphaned processes). While waiting, I'll check on the progress of the Docling pull.

action.command:
sleep 120; echo "=== docling pull ==="; cat /tmp/docling-pull.done 2>/dev/null || echo "still pulling"; tail -2 /tmp/docling-pull.log 2>/dev/null; echo "=== mem ==="; free -h | head -2; echo "=== process states ==="; cd /workspace; curl -sS http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys, json
from collections import Counter
d = json.load(sys.stdin)['data']
print(Counter(p['status'] for p in d))
for p in sorted(d, key=lambda x: x['name']):
    if p['status'] != 'Running':
        print(p['name'], p['status'], 'exit', p['exit_code'], 'restarts', p['restarts'])
" 2>&1
